title: Avatar4School 1.0 - pilot study
summary:
Every year, around 2,250 children and adolescents in Germany are diagnosed with cancer. Many of them are unable to go to school for a long time because of their treatment. As a result, they not only lose learning material, but also contact with friends and teachers - which can lead to loneliness and psychological stress. A so-called  avatar such as the AV1 can help: It stands in the classroom and enables the child to take part in lessons from home and keep in touch with the class. Initial experience shows that this supports social participation and learning. However, more detailed research is still lacking in Germany.
The Avatar4School 1.0 study is a pilot study in which teachers are asked via an online questionnaire about the perceived barriers and conditions for success of the use of avatars by children and adolescents with cancer in a school context. In addition, parents with a child suffering from cancer will be asked in individual interviews about the barriers and conditions for success of the use of avatars by children and adolescents with cancer in a school context whose child already uses or has used an avatar.
conditions: Mental health in children with cancer

interventions.name: Teachers with and without experience of using avatars at school (quantitative data collection). One-off online survey on the perceived barriers and conditions for success of the use of avatars by children and adolescents with cancer in a school context.

Parent of children with cancer with experience of using avatars at school (qualitative data collection). One-off individual interviews of the barriers and conditions for success of the use of avatars of children and adolescents with cancer in the school context described by affected parents.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Quantitative survey: completed teaching degree, German at native speaker level, stable internet access
Qualitative survey: Unspecified cancer in the child, German as mother tongue, access to a valid e-mail address and stable internet access, experience with the avatar in a school context, stable internet access, experience with the avatar in a school context
Exclusion criteria:
none
